data: In the top left plot, what is the training time of the yellow line at 100 features?

The top left plot shows the training time comparison for different machine learning algorithms and feature selection methods. The yellow line represents one of these methods. To find the training time of the yellow line at 100 features, I need to look at the y-axis value corresponding to the point where the x-axis reaches 100. From the graph, the yellow line appears to be around 2.0 seconds at 100 features.
